summary: This bill expands federal funding and establishes new grant programs to increase the number of service coordinators in various federally assisted housing projects, including those for the elderly, disabled, and in rural areas, to help residents access supportive services.

scores.thoughts: The bill authorizes significant appropriations for various service coordinator programs across multiple federal agencies (HUD, HRSA, USDA Rural Housing Service) for several fiscal years, totaling hundreds of millions of dollars. This directly increases authorized government spending.

The bill expands and creates new service coordinator programs in federally assisted housing, aiming to connect residents with supportive services for housing stability, health, and aging in place. This directly enhances and expands components of the social safety net by providing more resources and personnel to assist vulnerable populations.
